g.text: Post-Kijin snapshot · bounded terrain interpretation, not a kingdom survey or new settlement
Before: jungle extends across the vicinity
239,623 blocks² authored patch; 141,942 blocks² removed from one jungle edge (5.97% of that polygon).
14,975 biome cells change: 8,875 jungle + 6,100 plains → tensura:barren_land. All are inside the drawn patch.
All58 reservations /21 roads, complete height/water/road/site/exclusion outputs remain unchanged.
LN2 prologue directly supports exhausted soil and famine; wiki supplies broad southern bearings. Exact extent is ours.
No capital, ten-tribe layout, dimensional rift, sovereign border, active invasion or named resident is invented.
